highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too. It makes a server with a large chat history fast again after 0.79.0, and the new features below work there only then.
Use the OpenBot Apple Watch app when OpenBot on iPhone is closed. Your server answers the watch directly, end to end encrypted.
See the pointer and the selected step of each other person who has the same workflow open.
Spread agents over all your pooled provider accounts with the new Spread choice in Settings › Providers.
Type with no lag while an agent writes its reply, and use much less memory in long chats with many images.
